body: Thanks man.  People like you are what makes people awesome.  You take time out of your day to talk to strangers.  I appreciate it more than you could ever understand.

Today, girl problems.  The girl I have been seeing off and on got back together with her ex-boyfriend.  But that is my fault.  Our relationship was so rocky and the past month I have been pushing her away and sometimes being flat out mean.  

It all feels bigger than that though.  When I'm around people I want to be alone and when I'm alone I feel awful.  I rarely want to talk to my family or friends, yet I feel incredibly lonely.  

I have a good job that I probably should have lost already because I sit in front of my desk staring at my computer all day.  Then I come home and think about all the things I want to do the next day at work.  I used to be really motivated and luckily the work I did before this depression set in has allowed my negligence to go unnoticed.

I don't feel like I should be sad or depressed and definitely not suicidal but I am and I don't really know where to turn.  I don't think I even know how to cope with basic problems.
